title: Trail runner on the slip face

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph filling the entire frame edge to edge with no border, frame, letterbox band or matte of any kind. Read the sand-toned suede-and-mesh shoe named first as this trail runner, panel by panel: matte-coated clay-orange ripstop mesh is the whole field of the upper, with charcoal overlays on the toe bumper, the diagonal midfoot straps and the heel counter, and below them a chunky off-white outsole whose blocky lugs stand clearly proud with deep channels, on a charcoal midsole band - never a smooth cream midsole wrap, never gum rubber, never suede nap. It sits at a hard diagonal across the ripple bars, holding half the frame width, a small avalanche slumped from the heel, grains lodged in the lug channels. 135mm at f/8 from high on the crest straight down the slope, low sun raking from camera-right at the last hour; inside the cast shadow the ripple ridges and grains stay legible, only darker and cool lavender-grey, its outline reading as the shoe's silhouette. Backlit wind smoke crosses the top edge; combed grain runs unbroken out of the bottom and both sides. Unmarked.
